title: The protective role of long-term meditation on the decline of the executive component of attention in aging: a preliminary cross-sectional study
authors: Sperduti, M., Makowski, D., & Piolino, P.
summary: A cross-sectional comparison of long-term meditators and non-meditators across the adult lifespan, testing whether sustained practice buffers the age-related decline of attention. The protective association was specific to the executive component rather than to attention in general.
